next_event.source: No Investor Day found in Baba corpus. Next scheduled items: new CFO Grasher's first earnings call with Q3 2026 results (date not in corpus) and the first 2027 outlook; Teladoc One broad availability January 2027 (doc 110826).

margin_framing.metric_basis_note: Only one-year (FY2026) guides, all stated by the CEO because the CFO seat was vacant from 2025-11-21 to 2026-08-31: consolidated adjusted EBITDA $271M to $303M, about 85 bps of margin expansion vs 2025; Integrated Care 15.6% to 16.4%; BetterHelp 3.0% to 4.6%. Longer-term BetterHelp margin framing is qualitative. target_level_pct 11.93% is the guide midpoint ($287M / $2,405M revenue midpoint), derived. Calendar fiscal year, VA FY = company FY. current_level_pct = FY2025 VA EBITDA / revenue.

statements.quote: We expect adjusted EBITDA of $271 million-$303 million, up slightly at the midpoint versus the prior range, and representing approximately 85 basis points of margin expansion versus 2025.
statements.speaker: Chuck Divita

statements.quote: Our full year Integrated Care adjusted EBITDA margin guidance of 15.6%-16.4% is up 40 basis points at the midpoint versus our prior guidance range and represents an increase of approximately 85 basis points over 2025.
statements.speaker: Chuck Divita

statements.quote: With respect to BetterHelp's adjusted EBITDA margin, we continue to expect a range of 3.0%-4.6% for the full year and have aligned our actions to support our ability to invest in the insurance opportunity ahead.
statements.speaker: Chuck Divita

statements.quote: Ultimately, as that matures, you know, we do believe we're gonna see a margin profile that is certainly expands from where we are right now.
statements.speaker: Chuck Divita

street.gap_assumption: consensus_ebitda_margin_by_fy = VA consensus EBITDA / revenue (same basis as data_comps ebitda_margin). Adjusted EBITDA margin basis, calendar FY. FY2026 guide midpoint 11.93% vs FY2026 consensus 11.63% ($279.9M / $2,406.9M) = +30.6 bps (data_compute); consensus EBITDA sits in the lower half of the $271M to $303M range. No dated target beyond 2026. FY2027 consensus revenue ($2,379M) is below FY2026, margin 12.08%.
street.source: Baba data_financials fundamentals consensus (Visible Alpha), cid 1002934. Uplift = guide midpoint $287M vs FY2026 consensus $279.9M = +2.5% (one-year guide only).

evidence_of_progress.note: Consolidated adjusted EBITDA margin. Q1 2026 (VA actual) 9.48% vs 9.23% = +24.6 bps. Q2 2026 10.87% ($66M / $607M, CEO doc 110826; VA row still consensus) vs 10.97% = -9.6 bps. Integrated Care Q2 margin 16.5%, up about 190 bps YoY; BetterHelp Q2 margin 0.2% with revenue -11.6% as cash pay shrinks faster than insurance grows. 4-month forward EBITDA revision -2.99% (just inside the stabilized band), 12-month -9.4%. Net debt / LTM EBITDA 0.8x, 3.6x gross; 2027 convertibles to be addressed in two phases (doc 172434); cash $774M. No going-concern or covenant stress found.

verdict: Very cheap with a brand-new external CFO and a refreshed board, but margin framing is only a one-year guide about 31 bps above consensus and BetterHelp is still shrinking, so the setup awaits the CFO's first 2027 frame.
open_questions: Will CFO Grasher's first call (Q3 2026) or the 2027 outlook put a dated multi-year margin target on Integrated Care or BetterHelp?
Does the BetterHelp cash-pay decline push the 4-month EBITDA revision (now -2.99%) below -3% and cap D?
How will the 2027 convertible notes be refinanced, and at what cost to free cash flow?
